claim_scope: machine-only verification of a default-off, source-bounded multi-window data diagnostic; it makes no physical, no-residue, LUT, temperature, or production claim

diagnostic_contract.activation: one existing differential 0xFC/0x20/BUSY sequence after all selected regions
diagnostic_contract.lut_policy: no LUT byte was added, changed, or selected by this diagnostic
diagnostic_contract.physical_policy: not flashed; panel identity and White-rail prerequisites remain controlling
diagnostic_contract.region_selection: actual previous/current framebuffer byte differences; use multiple regions only when their total payload is smaller than one bounding window

disposition.allowed_next_step: only a gate-authorized physical diagnostic with canonical operator evidence after identity and White-rail prerequisites
disposition.observed_residue: unresolved; smaller payload cannot replace a panel-bound residue-recovery waveform
